findings.comment: sub.data() points into the underlying string without being null-terminated at digits length. std::strtol and std::strtof ignore the digits width and parse until encountering whitespace or an invalid character, which will misparse adjacent columns in fixed-format files. Additionally, std::strtof parses only single-precision floats, discarding double precision.

Using it != vi.end() with a stride of it += 12 (as well as in lines 282, 449, and 467) causes an infinite loop and buffer overrun if the remaining length is not an exact multiple of 12 (such as when lines have trailing whitespace or CRLF endings in binary mode). it skips right past vi.end() and never equals it.

points->SetPoint and mapNodes[node] = nodeID++ are executed outside the if (view.rfind(keyCodeCoord, 0) == 0) block. If a line does not start with keyCodeCoord, coords is empty, causing points->SetPoint to dereference coords.data() (nullptr), triggering a crash. nodeID is also erroneously incremented.

If grids is empty, multiBlock->SetNumberOfBlocks(0) is executed. Then multiBlock->SetBlock(0, grid) is called on index 0 of a dataset with 0 blocks, causing an out-of-bounds error or assertion failure in VTK.
